name: outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.DifferenceState.mk.noConfusion
type_text:
{d m n : ℕ} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {target count : ℕ} →
      {x y sum : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
        {pending : Fin n → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m)} →
          {clock : NNReal} →
            {rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow} →
              {nextID target' count' : ℕ} →
                {x' y' sum' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d} →
                  {pending' : Fin n → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m)} →
                    {clock' : NNReal} →
                      {rows' : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow} →
                        {nextID' : ℕ} →
                          { target := target, count := count, x := x, y := y, sum := sum, pending := pending,
                                clock := clock, rows := rows, nextID := nextID } =
                              { target := target', count := count', x := x', y := y', sum := sum', pending := pending',
                                clock := clock', rows := rows', nextID := nextID' } →
                            (target = target' →
                                count = count' →
                                  x ≍ x' →
                                    y ≍ y' →
                                      sum ≍ sum' →
                                        pending ≍ pending' → clock = clock' → rows = rows' → nextID = nextID' → P) →
                              P
